gitCommit.subject: fix(e2e): close AI Chat panel during canvas init + use testId selectors for TextV2
gitCommit.body:
fix(e2e): close AI Chat panel during canvas init + use testId selectors for TextV2

The AI Chat panel auto-opens when a canvas loads, covering the right-side
properties panel and blocking speech/TextV2 object interactions in e2e tests.

Changes:
- Add data-testid to chat close button, TextV2 textarea, and font size input
- Close AI Chat in handleInitialDialogs() so properties panel is accessible
- Update TextV2 tests to use specific data-testid selectors instead of fragile
  generic locators (textarea, input[type="number"])
- Add Escape + layers re-selection flow for font size test

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
